2122908284416053749.en_summary: @tig88411109 analyzes $NVDA latest Q3 financials and next quarter guidance fully beat expectations, crushing the bear thesis of semiconductor compute cycle peaking and valuation collapse. Highlights true moat in top-tier tech roadmap and engineering, Rubin first quarter $20B orders confirmed with 1 month deployment efficiency double previous and 10x token/watt vs Blackwell, implying 1GW Rubin revenue $40-50B per year. System engineering with own CPU/connect/security chips and CPO next year. Diversified revenue beyond cloud, supporting neoclouds, enterprises, sovereign. Refutes off-balance sheet concerns: $640B commitments mostly supply chain locks for wafers/HBM/packaging, $100B own cloud, $32B neocloud with conditions, OpenAI 20-year exclusive. Despite Huang exit short-term impact, fundamentals strong, valuation premium needs adjustment to long-term reasonable, event-driven buy points.
2122908284416053749.zh_summary: @tig88411109分析$NVDA最新Q3財務數據及下一季預測全面超預期，粉碎空頭關於半導體算力週期見頂及估值塌陷的論點。強調真正護城河在頂級技術路線及工程實現能力，Rubin第一季確認200億訂單，部署效率較上一代快一倍，token/瓦效率為Blackwell的十倍，意味1GW的Rubin年收入400-500億。系統工程包括自有CPU/連接/安全芯片及明年光互連CPO。收入多元化超越雲端大廠，扶持新雲、企業及主權。證偽表外擔憂：6400億承諾近4000億為供應鏈鎖定晶圓/HBM/封裝，1000億自用雲，320億新雲有條件，OpenAI 20年獨家。儘管黃仁勳離職有短期影響，基本面強勁，估值溢價需調整至中長期合理區間，事件性買入時點。
